citations.context: She has a question about Job 1.6. Um it says, now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them. Given that Satan is an adverse adversary and an unholy entity, how is he able to be in God's presence? Well, God can do whatever he wants.
